typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for engineering

rules.headings: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), medium to bold weights, never centered. Max fluid size text-4xl.
rules.data: Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric readouts, benchmark times, and coordinate data for precision alignment.

colors.rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors. Never use pure #000000 without texture. Text must meet APCA contrast ratios.

surfaces.panels: The 'Technical' Look (Grid Borders). Use border-collapse style layout where possible. Container background is solid. 1px borders (#262626) to expose the grid skeleton. No soft drop shadows.
surfaces.controls: Flat solid backgrounds, 1px subtle border, sharp or slight rounding (max 4px radius). High contrast on hover/focus.
surfaces.canvas: Solid dark gray (#1A1A1A) with an SVG grid pattern (10px increments, 1px line, stroke-white/10) to represent the mm/cm ruler.
surfaces.overlays: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80) and 1px inner stroke for modals or dropdowns. No fully transparent overlays.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards) - The Bento Protocol
rules: Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) to maximize screen real estate for the canvas.
Span logic: Left Sidebar (Controls/Stats/Benchmarks) spans 3 or 4 columns. Main Canvas spans 8 or 9 columns.
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch to match their neighbors.
Paddings on panels should be p-4 or p-6.

specific_overrides.button: Sharp edges (rounded-sm), flat colors, hover effect introduces subtle lift or high contrast text.
specific_overrides.card: Go cardless or use strictly rectangular dense styles with 1px border. No shadows.
specific_overrides.inputs: Solid dark background, 1px border, focus state must use primary brand color.
specific_overrides.tabs: Override fixed height (h-9 to h-auto), sharp underline or solid active state indicator.

custom_components.svg_canvas: The main visualizer must be a responsive SVG element. It should scale to fit the viewport (auto-fit mode) and include an SVG-based cm ruler around the edges. It must render polygons with their unique IDs and rotation angles.
custom_components.debug_overlays: Toggleable layers inside the SVG for bounding boxes, candidate positions, rejected positions, and collision areas.

rules: Use fast, sharp transitions (e.g., transition: all 0.1s ease-in-out) for buttons and inputs.
Avoid universal transitions (no 'transition: all' on grid items or canvas objects).
SVG nested objects can have a slight scale-in entrance animation if performance allows, but for large benchmarks (100+ objects), disable motion.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='nesting-run-button').
Focus states must have a 2px solid ring (#007AFF) and higher contrast than the default state.

visual_enhancers.ruler: A precise cm/mm ruler on the X and Y axes of the SVG canvas, rendered using SVG <line> and <text> elements with monospace font.
visual_enhancers.data_readouts: Use a monospace font with a 'digital meter' aesthetic for real-time stats (e.g., processing time, utilization %).
visual_enhancers.debug_mode: Use semi-transparent, highly contrasting neon colors for debug visualizations (e.g., neon pink for bounding boxes, bright cyan for candidates).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
The layout should be a high-density bento grid: Sidebar on the left for controls/stats (approx 30% width), and the main SVG canvas on the right (approx 70% width).
Implement the SVG canvas carefully: it must support a 'Fixed Height' vs 'Auto Height' view mode. The canvas should scale its viewBox to fit the container while maintaining aspect ratio.
The visualization must include a ruler (ticks every X cm) along the top and left edges.
Add a control panel with: Generate random objects, Nest, Clear, Reset, Spacing input, Rotation step input, Media width/height inputs.
Add a Benchmark panel to run 10/20/50/100 objects and display a results table with time, used height, utilization %, and failures.
Add a Debug mode toggle with layered overlays (bounding boxes, candidate positions, rejected positions, collision areas).
Follow the typography guidelines strictly: IBM Plex Sans for headings, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for data.
Ensure the theme is explicitly Dark Mode, utilizing the color palette defined above.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain a left-aligned, structured F-pattern reading flow.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, using 1px borders rather than soft shadows for this technical tool.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern, sharp button styles with interaction animations and relevant colors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠, etc.) for icons. Use lucide-react or Phosphor icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing within panels to prevent cramped text, while maintaining tight gaps between grid panels.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
